behavior.outnumbered_rule: Fresh sensed enemy fighters exceed nearby armed allies including self.
behavior.alien_swarm_rule: An isolated alien seeks nearby attackers fighting currently sensed enemies; joining is bounded and then combat resumes.
behavior.wall_scope: Local full-hull validated vertical and horizontal flank with supported floor exit, available to supported wall-capable alien fighters. Global navigation remains a floor graph.
behavior.taunt_scope: Normal gesture input and accepted EV_TAUNT event, with combat, low-health, service, regrouping and wall attachment guards and cooldown.

evidence.scope: Offline cheat fixtures with staged, paused and god-mode actors. Ordinary bot commands and Pmove resume after setup. These are controlled behavior checks, excluded from fair-match win rates, map-wide navigation and competitive balance claims.
evidence.provenance_note: The loaded game mode and requested registered profile were verified in each process. Exact raw JSONL and full parsed-record digests are retained; cross-mode identical floating trajectories are not asserted.
evidence.fixture_transform_note: The principal moving actors retain their fixture spawn and placement generations throughout motion assertions. Other actors are deliberately staged or reinforced. Synthetic spawn generations are not normal buildable-spawn counters.

fixture.scope: Synthetic server-only fixtures; never shipped game maps or balance evidence.

evidence.scope: Controlled offline cheat fixtures with staged, paused and god-mode actors; these prove collision queries and observed same-life autonomous wall movement, not normal-rules balance or map-wide navigation quality.
limitations: The wall test uses a synthetic static vertical wall and obstacle, with four nearby aliens and one staged stationary enemy.
A full-hull proved vertical-then-horizontal wall route is followed by normal Pmove; observed motion includes acceleration and overshoot.
The exact-19-riser jump-disabled negative uses deliberately extreme gravity; it is a collision control, not normal gameplay.
Cross-mode wall movement is qualified independently; native and QVM coordinates are not claimed equal.
No competitive balance, global wall surface graph, or unseen-player targeting claim follows from these fixtures.

evidence.scope: Normal-rules native 16v16 Arachnid2 physical observations; not a balance or decisive objective-success certification.

comparison.outcomes: draw->draw for all three pairs; all cores remain full; alien structure damage stays zero.

limitations: Three seeds are descriptive, not a statistical balance result.
Candidate and baseline differ in engine/game binaries and multiple navigation/team/taunt changes; a change cannot be attributed to one feature.
Baseline snapshots are 30 seconds apart and lack physical generation and tactics; fine trajectory and membership evidence is candidate-only.
Periodic 500ms sampling cannot prove every intervening footstep, sighting or brief completed wall maneuver.
Current body/world traces to an unexecuted goal and historical movement_reason do not establish a continuous collision stall.
Legacy wave and launch counters changed meaning to local formations/member changes; they are excluded from baseline behavioral comparisons.
A changed member_ids tuple proves sampled membership adaptation, not effective coordinated offense.
All three matches draw and aliens damage no buildings; observed wall movement and withdrawals do not establish a successful swarm attack.

normal_compiled_qvm_long.scope: Three 900-second normal-rules compiled-QVM 16v16 matches; one seed on each of three maps. Separate outcomes from native; no cross-mode identity claim.

evidence.scope: Five isolated native normal-rule short runs; early simulation, replay, observational-cadence, accepted-taunt and complete-62-bot telemetry checks. This does not certify competitive balance, interpreted/compiled-QVM equivalence, all-map navigation, or late-game behavior.
evidence.interpretation: All62 registered bots are present in every large-match snapshot, including queued bots; this does not mean all62 spawned physically within31 seconds. Taunt evidence comes from accepted EV_TAUNT callbacks, latest player-state event-ring entries and positive PM_Gesture timers, rather than requested gesture buttons. Repeated runs are not independent balance samples. Time-limit draws are distinct from game-end wins. Short runs show no kills or structure damage.

excluded_attempts.reason: Superseded by the frozen 145daaed runtime; no transfer of old outcomes.
Helper analysis used a later swarm snapshot instead of the first actual merge; corrected analysis and replacement runs are the authoritative controlled evidence.
Controller could not reach its local server; replaced by the successful isolated smoke recorded here.

limitations: All six normal 900-second native and compiled-QVM matches ended in time-limit draws; alien building damage was zero in every match. Cooperation and motion evidence does not establish effective base offense or balanced play.
Long stationary attacker episodes remain. The update does not guarantee successful navigation of every stair, choke point or map passage.
Controlled behavior fixtures use staged players and isolated cheat-gated probes. They are excluded from fair economy and balance evidence.

Native natural motion counts are finite sampled observations. Membership changes are correlated per-member observations, not independent squads; wall attachment alone is not a completed flank or tactical success.
Grounded natural wall completions require active attached travel, a completion increment, and actual sampled WORLD floor grounding near the planned exit; they do not prove an objective attack.
Native v0.2 comparisons change multiple navigation/team behaviors and engine versions; no isolated causal improvement is certified. Native alien kills decreased in these three matched seeds.
Complete 62-bot telemetry confirms roster serialization, not that all 62 bots physically spawned during a short sample.

Graphical preview verifies follow and free-flight mode rendering. The free-flight camera was partly occluded, manual camera movement was not tested, stock weapon animation fallbacks remain, and audio audibility was not tested.
Historical checkpoint files in the package apply only to their own recorded runtime hashes.
